findings.vulnerability: CORS configuration allows requests from all origins, which can lead to security issues.
findings.recommendation: Specify allowed origins in production to limit exposure.

findings.vulnerability: Allowing all HTTP methods exposes unnecessary APIs.
findings.recommendation: Restrict allowed methods to only those necessary for the application.

findings.vulnerability: Accepting all headers increases risk of processing malicious headers.
findings.recommendation: Specify necessary headers explicitly to reduce risk exposure.
